description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RecommendationTweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Internship" name="Internship" processRef="Process_Internship"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RecommendationTweets"
                      name="Recommendation tweets"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTweet"
                      targetRef="Participant_Twitter"
                      messageRef="Message_RecommendationTweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterTopicAndMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WeeklyTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplicantUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecommendCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RecommendationsSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Search" name="Begin internship search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny the offer?" default="Flow_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Begin internship updates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WeeklyTimer" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicantUpdates" name="Write at least 3 internship status updates every week"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternshipFinished" name="Has the internship finished?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecommendCompany" name="Recommend the company to a list of friends via Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweet" name="Send a separate tweet to each friend" messageRef="Message_RecommendationTweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RecommendationsSent" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Search" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">acceptOffer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Event_WeeklyTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_WeeklyTimer" targetRef="Task_ApplicantUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ApplicantUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueWeeklyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Event_WeeklyTimer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternshipFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_RecommendCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Task_SendTweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="End_RecommendationsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
